subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI cannot queue input while Gateway reconnects

question: Should the maintainer-labeled Control UI reconnect composer bug be promoted as a narrow fix now or batched with broader capability-state cleanup?
rationale: The source bug is narrow and reproducible, but the protected `maintainer` label means ClawSweeper should not auto-close or auto-dispatch a repair without explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Promote narrow fix
options.body: Split compose/queue capability from transport connectivity in the chat props and add focused browser E2E coverage for reconnect queueing.

options.title: Batch with capability cleanup
options.body: Keep this open while maintainers handle it with the adjacent capability-state issues, accepting that the Control UI reconnect composer remains blocked until then.

recommendation.title: Promote narrow fix
recommendation.body: Split compose/queue capability from transport connectivity in the chat props and add focused browser E2E coverage for reconnect queueing.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the mounted reconnect-shell work that exposes this remaining Control UI gap and is the clearest current routing owner from history.
